description: We need to download a few additional components to ensure everything runs smoothly.
downloadCompleteMessage: Download complete! Click below to run the installer.

hydraRunning.title: Hydra is still running
hydraRunning.body: Close Hydra so the previous installation data can be removed, then try again.

cleanupFailed.title: Couldn't remove previous data
cleanupFailed.body: The Hydra folder in AppData couldn't be moved to the Recycle Bin. It was left untouched.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.body: Hydra's servers couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.

unreachable.title: Can't reach Hydra's servers
unreachable.body: The connection timed out. Check your connection or firewall, then try again.

serverError.title: Hydra's servers had a problem
serverError.body: The download service returned an error. Wait a few minutes and try again.

badRelease.title: Couldn't find the latest release
badRelease.body: The release information Hydra received was incomplete. This usually fixes itself in a few minutes.

interrupted.title: Download interrupted
interrupted.body: The connection dropped at {progress}. The download starts over when you try again.

diskFull.title: Not enough disk space
diskFull.body: Free up space on your Windows drive, then try again.

fileError.title: Couldn't save the installer
fileError.body: Windows blocked writing to your Temp folder. Check your antivirus, then try again.

launchFailed.title: The installer didn't start
launchFailed.body: Windows or your antivirus stopped the installer from opening. Try again and allow it to run.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: The installation couldn't continue. Try again. If it keeps happening, the details below help when reporting it.
